hints.content:
Similarly, Diana spends $1.2y$ dollars on cantaloupes and $z\cdot p$ dollars on milk.

Ingredient | Price per kilogram | Amount | $\goldD{\text{Price}}$
:-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
Bananas | $0.55$ dollars per kilogram | $x$ kilograms | $\goldD{0.55x\text{ dollars}}$
Cantaloupes | $y$ dollar per kilogram | $1.2$ kilograms | $\goldD{1.2y\text{ dollars}}$
Milk | $z$ dollars per liter | $p$ liters | $\goldD{zp\text{ dollars}}$

The total amount Diana spends on ingredients, $2$ dollars, is the sum of the prices of each ingredient:

$2=0.55x+1.2y+zp$

question.content:
Diana is making smoothie using bananas, cantaloupes, and milk. This table gives the cost, per kilogram, of each ingredient, and the amount, in kilograms, that Diana uses:

Ingredient | Price per kilogram | Amount
:-: | :-: | :-:
Bananas | $0.55$ dollars per kilogram | $x$ kilograms
Cantaloupes | $y$ dollar per kilogram | $1.2$ kilograms
Milk | $z$ dollars per liter | $p$ liters

The total cost of the ingredients is $2$ dollars.

**Write an equation that relates $x$, $y$, $z$, and $p$.**

[[☃ expression 1]]
